clips.topic: The bear-market bottom is being front-run, another influencer finally says it too, and the four-year cycle zombies will FOMO October green
clips.title: The Bottom Is Being Front-Run
clips.hook_summary: This is the first time I found somebody that actually says the same things as me about October, although he does not use my phrase, four-year cycle zombies. Do not wait until October to buy Bitcoin: the bottom is being front-run, behind us or very soon in August. Proof: September is always red in a post-halving year, so last year everybody and their grandma sold in August, created the August low, and September turned green for the first time. Now all these four-year cycle zombies come back in October, push those candles green like crazy, and get so overwhelmed with FOMO we will have to schedule them a psychiatrist appointment.

This is the batch-namesake topic and the canonical conviction-wearing-a-macro-coat exception to the no-market-readout rule. Persona drafting rule respected: zombies make October green; the bottom prints BEFORE October.

Proof then payoff, contiguous: September-always-red got front-run, everybody sold in August, created that low, September turned green for the first time; now the zombies come back in October, push candles green like crazy, FOMO psychiatrist, buy back in and push it further; that is my whole idea what is going to happen in October.
